summary: Frontend-only smoke + interaction test for Clelia & Co. Design Studio. All 34 UI checks passed: home hero + brand logo + nav render, hero CTA navigates to /studio, Design Studio steps 1->2->3->4 advance correctly (prompt <12 chars blocks advance with toast, chip appends to prompt), both GPT Image 1 and Gemini Nano Banana model buttons render and selection toggles is-selected class, concepts gallery shows 3 concepts, selecting a concept exposes View in 3D and Request a private quote actions, request quote fires success toast, customer login exposes email + password + Google button and no TOTP input, staff login exposes email + password + authenticator (TOTP) input and no Google button, staff dashboard renders sidebar, orders table with all 3 seeded orders and restricted manufacturing (secure-print-files-panel), sidebar nav updates page title. Mobile 390px viewport shows no horizontal overflow on Home or Studio. No critical browser console errors captured.

ui_bugs.issue: The logo renders inside a solid white/ivory rounded box that sits over the dark hero image on desktop, creating a floating white rectangle around the mark. Consider a transparent PNG or removing the container background so the logo integrates with the hero.

When a jewellery type is selected on mobile, the card fills with plum and the '01' index label and item name both appear in a dark tone on plum, reducing contrast (the '01' is nearly invisible on the selected 'Ring' card in the mobile screenshot).
'Create an account' link uses to={location.pathname}, so clicking it just re-navigates to the same login page. Should point to a real signup route or open a signup form.

issues: Logo bounded by opaque light card sits awkwardly over the hero image on desktop
Selected type-card contrast between index numeral and plum background is low

action_items: Make the header logo container transparent (or use a transparent-background logo) so it does not appear as a floating white block over the hero image.
Improve contrast of the type-index numeral and label on the selected .type-card state (use ivory/champagne text on plum).
Wire the 'Create an account' link to a real signup route rather than location.pathname.
Continue to be aware that concept images, 3D/AR buttons, and staff orders are documented mocked data awaiting integration credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js keeps all routes on a single JSX line, making diffs and future route additions error-prone. Consider formatting the Routes tree across multiple lines.
DesignStudioPage.jsx and StaffDashboardPage.jsx also collapse large JSX trees onto single lines which harms maintainability; splitting into named subcomponents would help.
LoginPage submit handler only calls event.preventDefault() with no auth call — expected per current scope but should be flagged so it isn't shipped as-is.
Reference upload input (<input type=file multiple>) has no client-side file count / size validation despite 'Up to 5 images' copy.
Concept selection state is not reset when the user goes Back from step 4 to step 3, but step 4 has no Back control at all — user must reload to change earlier choices from concepts.
Staff dashboard is reachable directly at /staff/dashboard without any auth guard. Acceptable in this foundation pass but must be gated once auth lands.
test_credentials: None used; auth is not wired yet per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors used in review_request are present and working. Studio flow validation: step 2 requires prompt.length >= 12 (uses toast.error). Model selector state persists via 'is-selected' class. Staff dashboard route is /staff/* and renders unauthenticated. When auth/backend generation lands, add pytest suite under /app/backend/tests and re-verify request-quote button now hits API.
